tickets.name: Bills -5.5
tickets.why: Detroit down 2 O-line starters and both starting safeties; Buffalo has nobody ruled out. Pinnacle has this as a pick'em (50%) but the health gap supports 54% vs. DK's -110 (52.4% breakeven).
tickets.kill_switch: If D.J. Reed (Lions CB, foot) is downgraded to OUT at 6:45 PM ET inactives and the price moves worse than -125, pull this ticket and move the $10 into Ticket 2 (making the SGP stake $15 total).

legs.label: Bills -5.5
legs.why: Lions are missing 2 O-line starters (Mahogany hip, Miller knee) and both starting safeties (Branch, Joseph); Bills have nobody ruled out. combined_edge -0.024, but own estimate 54% clears DK's 52.4% breakeven and sits inside Pinnacle's band (fair 50%).

tickets.name: Lions ML + Under 54.5
tickets.why: Dog plus under, correlated on purpose: an upset is more likely a low-scoring, controlled game given Detroit's O-line attrition. Also fades the 96%-of-tickets public pile onto Over. Joint estimate ~21% (higher than the naive 18% product since the legs are positively correlated) vs. a 20% breakeven at +400.
tickets.kill_switch: DK's SGP builder price is not fetchable via API -- verify in app. Minimum acceptable price +400; below that, skip the SGP and take $5 straight on Under 54.5 (+100, VERIFIED) instead. If a late Detroit skill-position scratch hits beyond what's already priced, drop the Lions ML leg and take Under 54.5 alone for the $5.

legs.label: Lions ML (SGP leg)
legs.why: Dog+under correlation: an upset is more likely a tight, low-scoring script given Detroit's O-line attrition. combined_edge -0.015; own estimate 34% clears DK's 32.8% breakeven, within Pinnacle's band (fair 31.3%).

legs.label: Under 54.5 (SGP leg)
legs.why: Fades the public's 96%-of-tickets/93.8%-of-handle pile onto Over (Rule 6); short-week-under trend regressed against both offenses' hot Week 1s. combined_edge -0.015; own estimate 53% clears DK's 50% breakeven, within Pinnacle's band (fair 50.5%).
